name: Investigate the Alchemist Shop
summary: An arcane disturbance has brought invisible creatures into Algernon's shop in the Undercity. Anastasia Hartwell sends Horde mages to reveal and contain them before they can cause harm.

sections.title: A Disturbance in the Apothecarium
sections.body: Anastasia Hartwell sends arcane initiates to investigate a disturbance in the Apothecarium. Invisible magical creatures have been wandering through Algernon's alchemy shop, among its cauldrons and reagents. The Undercity's mage instructor suspects a breach in the flow of magic. The creatures must be contained before they cause serious damage.

sections.title: Manifestation and Containment
sections.body: Anastasia gives her students a Cantation of Manifestation to reveal the invisible creatures, along with sturdy containment coffers. Ordinary tracking cannot find beings made entirely of raw arcane force. Once visible, the rift spawns must be weakened and sealed in the coffers before they can unravel further or harm the alchemists at work.

sections.title: Accident or Arcane Assault?
sections.body: Anastasia wants to learn where the creatures came from. A spontaneous rift in the flow of magic is troubling; an intentional breach could mean a coordinated magical assault on the Forsaken capital. The captured creatures go to Undercity scholars for study, who must determine whether the Apothecarium suffered an accident or faces a targeted threat.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where do I find them?
faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell, the mage trainer, offers this in the Undercity's Magic Quarter.
The disturbance is in Algernon's alchemy shop, in the Undercity's Apothecarium district.

faq.q: What are the creatures wandering the shop?
faq.answer: The creatures are rift spawns, invisible beings made of concentrated magical energy that appeared through an anomaly in the local flow of magic.

faq.q: How do you capture the creatures?
faq.answer: You recite the Cantation of Manifestation in the shop to reveal the rift spawns, weaken them with spells, then use a containment coffer to trap them.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia want these creatures captured alive?
faq.answer: Anastasia and the Undercity's scholars need live specimens to learn whether the tear in magic came from a natural rift or an intentional attack on the city by an outside magical force.

faq.q: Can classes other than mages do this quest?
faq.answer: Only Horde mages can take part; this is part of their early training.

angles.text: As a mage, you test your command of arcane forces with manifestation cantations and containment vessels, not destructive force alone.
As Forsaken, you see the Undercity's arcane scholars guarding the city against magical infiltration, alongside apothecaries focused on alchemy and plaguecraft.
